title: First Burrow
intro: The wedding flight is over. The Queen has bitten off her own wings and chosen a patch of dirt under the rhubarb.
Five loyal workers stand ready. Above them, a whole yard of giants. Below them, nothing but soil and possibility.
outro: The first new ants stumble out of their cocoons, pale and confused.
Antonia, a scout who claims to be older than the rhubarb, sniffs them and declares them 'adequate'.

objectives.text: Give the Queen a royal chamber
Dig a nursery for the brood

params.speaker: Queen
params.text: My children, the sun is hot and the birds are hungry. We go down. Now.

params.speaker: Antonia
params.text: Antonia, senior scout. Yes, there's only five of you. No, that's not my problem. Dig.

params.speaker: Queen
params.text: A fine chamber. A little damp. I shall lay anyway, because someone has to.

params.speaker: Antonia
params.text: Larvae. All mouth, no manners. Just like me at that age.

params.speaker: Queen
params.text: Welcome, little ones. You were born for one purpose: everything.
